title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. translated_title: ForecastGym：一个面向预测智能体的实时、可控且可回放的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的智能体越来越多地通过搜索网络并对所找到的信息进行推理来预测真实世界事件。此类智能体的预测好坏既取决于检索到的证据，也取决于模型本身，因此对证据的控制对于评估至关重要。当每个系统各自进行搜索时，实时评估会将检索与推理混杂在一起，而回溯式搜索则可能通过日期过滤器或历史页面在当今的排名泄露后续信息。要比较不同的模型、搜索来源和记忆策略，既需要固定的证据，也需要该证据在问题揭晓前如何演变的记录。我们提出了 ForecastGym，它每两天记录四个商业网络搜索 API 针对开放预测市场问题所返回的结果，并在结果揭晓后离线回放这些冻结的证据，从而在固定的证据获取策略下比较模型、记忆以及所捕获的搜索来源。其首个发布版本涵盖1（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ForecastGym 通过每两天记录四个商业搜索引擎 API 对预测市场问题的返回结果，并在结果揭晓后离线回放这些冻结证据，首次实现了在固定证据获取策略下对预测智能体的模型、记忆与搜索来源的公平、可控比较。
en_tdlr: ForecastGym records web search results from four commercial APIs every two days for prediction-market questions and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, enabling controlled and fair comparison of forecasting agents' models, memory, and search sources.
